pr199.title: perf(eval): borrow oracle text and synchronize V18 status test
pr199.body:
## Why this change is needed

Canonical database parity currently allocates an owned String for each SQLite text cell before serializing that row. The oracle can borrow those cell values for the row's lifetime while preserving the exact canonical bytes and existing error behavior.

The donor branch's ordinary closeout also exposed a V18 test race: the test obtained a point-in-time status snapshot before checking whether the mock HTTP request had started. A later positive request count could select that earlier snapshot with zero pending work. The original failed execution is retained.

## Changes

- Integrate the exact reviewed PR190 oracle implementation and four correctness controls onto current main `09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7`. Borrow text only during row serialization; preserve field/duplicate-column ordering, numeric encoding, escaped-byte budgets, SELECT error order, read-only access, dual scratch spools and existing limits.
- In the V18 loopback test, observe the existing request barrier before obtaining one fresh status snapshot. Keep every pending/semantic/dense/ready assertion, semaphore release, timeout and provider boundary unchanged. The repair does not retry until the pending assertion happens to pass.
- Add the nonauthor canonical review and support, then update the original source registry's five changed fields and four identity pins. The complete domain is 1,096 product inputs / 79 original-BASE differences / 146 unchanged validation inputs. No workflow changes are included.

The source commits are `d2b853b6…` (oracle integration) and `2b6e9ebf…` (V18 synchronization), followed by review `ca10314f…` and bound head **`4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`**, tree `6518a5b317683a24ded3a69b027da6a04b8c996c`.

## Validation and evidence

The [independent source review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/ca10314fbc5a4ffa28ada5b7c1097c1091b48aa4/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009/independent-source-review.json) accepts this exact composition. Its author/reviewer roles remain explicit.

The original v15 verifier actually exited 0 on this G, including the original previous-v14 proof, with all 1,435 selected inputs and actual HEAD/index unchanged. The original task-plan check then passed with all 1,441 required inputs unchanged and confirmed 192 total / 164 done / 28 remaining. Its first attempt failed because six committed plan documents were not materialized in the source-verifier view; that failure is preserved alongside the exact-input recovery and successful original invocation. No source or task status was changed to obtain that result. [Complete admission outputs, original ZIPs, both task-plan attempts and independent binding bridges](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a75a38263c53d5294b0022019be90193ff4e7bbf/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-borrowed-oracle-main-integration-bfcc-20261009) are retained.

**New-head Rust and ordinary CI are pending at PR creation.** They must verify this actual composition; the donor's earlier CI is not relabeled as execution of this head. In particular, the V18 repair has a static explanation and still needs its actual post-change execution.

PR190's [independently named finite observation](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004163561) belongs to `f6750cad…`, with all five cases × 20 pairs retained. Its descriptive paired medians are approximately 0.830–0.960 borrowed/original, with all five slower pairs included. [Complete original ZIP/log and independent analysis](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/07308326c3a658bc3f0e8d0cae85f9218bf960fe/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-bfcc-20261009) support only that finite mechanism scope. The older, order-dependent results remain in [PR190](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/pull/190). No current-main, full-indexing or 100k speedup is claimed.

The [original V18 failure and exact proposed repair](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a7791788ee2bf5da26f8b8048c284bff951ead05/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-closeout-failure-bfcc-20261009) remain archived: 11 passed / 1 failed / Cargo101. Its log does not prove the unique runtime interleaving.

## Task and integration boundary

This PR changes zero original TODO statuses. Current main remains **164/192 done, 28 remaining**; only P8-005 has newly completed in the active user task. All original scale-study identities, cohorts, seeds, budgets and deadlines remain unchanged. The ignored cost probes remain available as ignored tests; this PR does not add their triggering workflows.

Reverting this PR restores both source leaves and their prior reviewed-source binding together.

pr190.title: perf(oracle): borrow row text during exact canonical serialization
pr190.body:
## Purpose and behavior

Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a`**. It is a normal fast-forward of the previously prepared P/R/G chain from formatter-only head `9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`, adding the separate equal-lifetime ignored diagnostic and dedicated workflow. All prior production serialization, regular controls, the original ignored probe and its workflow remain byte-preserved.

## Historical correctness verification at 9ddae

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Adoption was held at the original cost review; current-main integration remains pending.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

The previously archived equal-lifetime candidate was published by normal fast-forward on 2026-10-09 at 23:22:51 UTC. The sole new `p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run` label was added at 23:23:16 UTC to request its independently named bounded observation. This is not a rerun, correction or replacement of the original 100-pair study. The new workflow directly checks out head `f6750cad…`; the new ordinary test-merge `17cef1ccd9eb51099e0aed9faab466edb28316fc` has parents `[fffd950d…, f6750cad…]` and the exact complete head tree `4d49ddd5e61b9b32f2677a9966c3326c336aec0e`.

The existing protocol retains five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs and 256 rows per side. Both sides keep one common immutable reference; each side verifies, hashes and drops its own result vector before the next timer. Allocator/cache/order effects remain explicit. The workflow retains source/toolchain/observer identities, complete outputs, producer metadata and the executed ELF's post-run hash; it does not archive ELF bytes, so independent later ELF-byte rehash is unavailable from that artifact alone. At publication time, no new diagnostic result or new-head CI success had been claimed. The independently verified terminal diagnostic is recorded below; ordinary new-head CI remains a separate record.

The label-event review confirms only the new observation job matches that label. The separate head update also starts the repository's ordinary new-head CI, including runtime/soak, under their existing conditions. Those runs keep their new source identities and do not replace the three original scale/cold studies.

## Actual equal-lifetime observation and next integration step

The independently named [run 38004163561, attempt 1](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004163561) completed successfully at source `f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a`. The original Cargo child exited 0 and libtest reported 1 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored. Its exact full log and original artifact `11650632746` were retained once, followed by a nonauthor analysis that actually exited 0.

All 100 unique pairs, five cases × 20 pairs × 256 rows, were accepted. All original/borrowed/reference digests match after the native full-row equality assertions. Each case retains ten pairs for each execution order. Ratios below are descriptive paired `borrowed_ns / original_ns`; no performance threshold was added.

| Case | All 20-pair median | Original-first median | Borrowed-first median | Faster / slower pairs |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| multiple_text | 0.960259 | 0.952529 | 0.977407 | 18 / 2 |
| short_fields | 0.830247 | 0.826431 | 0.837201 | 20 / 0 |
| blob | 0.937696 | 0.935336 | 0.943234 | 20 / 0 |
| empty_text | 0.884909 | 0.873277 | 0.895401 | 19 / 1 |
| null | 0.867901 | 0.840527 | 0.882010 | 18 / 2 |

All five slower pairs are retained, including the largest ratio 1.172166 for null round 4. The data supports the finite mechanism direction on these constructed inputs. Timers include SELECT traversal, serialization and output retention, and the remaining allocation/cache history is not reset. It does not identify isolated sub-costs, establish that output lifetime caused the old result, or prove current-main, 100k or end-to-end gains. The old v1 results remain unchanged and separate.

[Complete original ZIP, job log, terminal API records, independent verdict and full analysis](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/07308326c3a658bc3f0e8d0cae85f9218bf960fe/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-bfcc-20261009) are now durable. The original producer records a fresh release cc_eval test executable of 28,876,408 bytes, SHA256 `fc5ac08708626b1cee63de1a19c0e98de30c8a264059297f476dd4ef1f844696`; this protocol does not archive ELF bytes or per-row raw outputs.

Root accepted the finite diagnostic and actually opened [PR199](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/pull/199) against main `09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7`, with reviewed head `4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111`. It carries the exact oracle implementation and correctness tests plus the independently reviewed minimal V18 status/barrier repair described below. The original source verifier and task-plan checks actually passed before publication, with unchanged selected input bytes/modes and HEAD/index. [Actual publication and exact test-merge identity](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/2b1d5f1e9d24475c2d6aa6efab72a6c1d9bcb1e1/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round31-PR199-publication-bfcc-20261010) are retained. As of the finite 00:27 UTC observation on 2026-10-10, new-head main and closeout jobs remained in progress; the V18-containing step had actually succeeded and the one-hour soak was running. This fixed-base donor PR remains Draft until the separate integration is fully verified and reconciled. No original scale run, plan, threshold or task status changes accompany the integration.

## Current-head ordinary CI failure and proposed repair

As observed on **2026-10-10 UTC**, the 32 check runs on `f6750cad…` comprise 25 successes, five conditional skips, one still-running soak, and one failure. The [ordinary main regression job](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004132942/job/114068898219) succeeded at 23:45:53 UTC. This does not make the full ordinary CI suite green.

The [original closeout job](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004132959/job/114068898390) failed in `loopback::ready_publication_status_keeps_request_policy_and_per_query_coverage_distinct`: the V18 target reported 11 passed / 1 failed, with Cargo exit 101, when `semantic_pending > 0` observed zero. The original source reads status before checking the mock request counter, so the counter may advance after that snapshot. The original run has no ordering trace that would establish this as the unique cause.

A separately reviewable minimal test change now checks the existing mock-request barrier before taking the fresh status snapshot. The mock still holds its first HTTP response behind its original semaphore. All semantic, dense-state and pending-work assertions, the existing deadlines and the loopback-only provider remain unchanged. The original test is identical at this donor head and the main09 base. The repair is now independently source-reviewed and included as a separate commit in PR199. Its complete new-source CI and merge are still pending; the finite 00:27 UTC official record shows the V18-containing step succeeded, without substituting that step result for the remaining checks.

The [complete original failed-job log, original artifact reconstructed from all 27 ordered binary chunks, official failure records and exact proposed patch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/a7791788ee2bf5da26f8b8048c284bff951ead05/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-closeout-failure-bfcc-20261009) are retained. The prior incomplete capture is explicitly preserved next to a corrected record with fresh official API responses. No failure was removed or treated as a passing rerun. This CI repair and integration preparation add zero original-task completion credit.

## Preserved evidence and scope

The [original ZIP custody branch](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/evidence/p8-originals-oracle-eded-a217-20261009) preserves the complete original artifact, job log, restoration hashes and all cost records. The original formatter failure, its later repair and the correction of an unsupported metadata capture timestamp remain explicit history.

[The original public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) retains the earlier fixed reviews and execution receipts. [The recovered candidate and event review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/0727385f83c143043dca3f68fb85baebac3168df/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round29-PR190-existing-equal-lifetime-preparation-bfcc-20261009) binds the unchanged existing candidate, its original source/task admission, and this later publication decision.

No full 150/1500 matrix, workload speedup, release approval or original TODO completion is claimed here. This fixed historical review branch retains its original **163/192 done, 29 remaining** task snapshot. Current main separately has **164/192 done, 28 remaining**, with only **P8-005** newly completed in the active task. This PR and its diagnostic add **0** original-task completion credit.
